report.assessment: LAB-0225 is a newly available (2024-12-01T12:00:00Z) action-level upstream bioburden result for in-process batch BATCH-075 (Famotidine Injection, USP, sterile solution, LINE-A, started 06:40Z same day): relative_bioburden_signal 1.23 action-limit ratio vs action limit 1.0 (123% of limit, +23%) and alert limit 0.7, status 'action'. The value is consistent across four laboratory sources (lims_export, microbiology_results, lims_review_local 123.0%, scanned_lab_review OCR pending human visual review) and is the maximum of all 153 in-scope LIMS bioburden results. Two prior action-level results exist (SYN-0004 1.08, 2024-02-21; SYN-0014 1.06, 2024-04-01) on other products/lines; both batches were later released, with no QA rationale or deviation records in scope. Scope of the event: BATCH-075 same-morning signals include companion sample PRE-LAB-001 0.79 (alert, collected five minutes after the LAB-0225 sample) and environmental sample EM-0075 0.71 (alert, process support area); BATCH-075 is the only in-scope batch combining an alert-level EM signal with an action-level bioburden result. No equipment fault, maintenance action (log ends 2024-10-25), deviation, or operator anomaly exists in the BATCH-075 window; the only non-normal process event is a low-severity AREA-CORE differential-pressure-margin reading (PROC-0299, 0.9615 vs expected_high 1.0, 09:10Z). Competing explanations remain open: a true environment-coupled process excursion (supported by the same-morning signal cluster and historical EM/bioburden co-elevation days) versus a sampling/analytical artifact (supported by the 55.7% disagreement between two samples drawn five minutes apart). A recording error is effectively excluded by four-source agreement pending the PDF visual check. Human QA review is required before any disposition: retest/orthogonal assay of the retained sample, laboratory run review, HVAC/area pressure logs, and retrieval of the historical action-level disposition rationale are the decisive next steps. This investigation does not approve or execute any disposition, CAPA or release action.

report.cross_scope_synthesis: Cross-source synthesis: the scoped package is internally consistent about LAB-0225 - four laboratory recording systems carry the same 1.23/123% action-limit value for BATCH-075, and the local-time display (UTC-07) is documented as the same instant as UTC. Plant-wide, 12 of 153 LIMS bioburden results are at or above the 0.7 alert limit and 3 at or above the 1.0 action limit; LAB-0225 (1.23) is the in-scope maximum and the only action result accompanied by a same-morning alert-level environmental signal (EM-0075 0.71). Historical patterns split: SYN-0018/0029/0032 show co-elevated EM and sub-action bioburden on the same days, while the two prior action-level results (SYN-0004, SYN-0014) occurred without EM elevation and ended in release - so neither a pure environment story nor a pure known-variability story fits all the data. Prior low-severity pressure-margin events (e.g. SYN-0007, SYN-0031, SYN-0045) did not co-occur with elevated laboratory results, weakening a simple environment-coupling mechanism; conversely the only high-severity equipment event (SYN-0015, PUMP-02, 2024-04-05) did co-occur with an alert-level bioburden result. Equipment, maintenance, deviation and operator sources show no abnormality in the BATCH-075 window; the maintenance log ends 2024-10-25 and the historian reuses three equipment entities across all batches with no equipment-to-line mapping, both disclosed as coverage gaps. All 1049 deterministic screening flags are missing_source_time clock-quality artifacts on static limit columns; no value-based anomaly was flagged anywhere, so review effort correctly concentrated on the LAB-0225 cluster. Method limits: several historical historian units were reviewed via complete severity sweeps plus screening rather than row-by-row reads (disclosed per unit); the scanned PDF and package manifest reads were truncated at 32 cells with the unread remainder characterized as same-format content; one specialist session (lab-baseline) did not deliver its checkpoint before submission and its assigned questions were answered by direct lead reads of the same sources. Evidence outside the package (retest data, historical QA rationale, HVAC logs, EM trend) remains outstanding and is listed as explicit evidence requests.
